title: System card
description: One system under test: systems/<id>.json. Checked by python3 -m bambench check-cards.

id.description: System id. Must equal the file name without .json.

name.description: Display name shown in the dashboard.

kind.description: Implementation in bambench.systems that runs this card (checked against KINDS).

model.description: Hugging Face repository of the weights, as owner/name.

released.description: Release month as YYYY-MM (a bare year where the month is not known).

license.description: Licence of the weights, as stated by the publisher.

params.description: Parameter count as text, such as 9B, or small for a classic pipeline.

weights_gb.description: Size of the weights download in GB.

slice.description: GPU slice the system needs: CPU, or a size such as 40 GB.

gpu.description: Free-text note on GPU memory use, such as about 8 GB or optional.

serve.description: vllm serve command the job starts for this system, without --port.

page_prompt.description: Prompt sent with each page image; empty sends the image alone.

output.description: Converter turning the model's native output into Markdown (see bambench.systems.outputs).

handles.description: What the publisher claims the model handles: true, false, or null when not stated.

revision.description: Commit of the weights snapshot that was benchmarked, 7 to 40 hex characters.

notes.description: Free-text notes on setup, caveats and history.

status.description: Set only to override: pending, active, failed, superseded or withdrawn. Normally left out and worked out from results.

status_note.description: One sentence on the status, such as why a system has not run yet.

superseded_by.description: Id of the card that replaces this one. Set exactly when status is superseded.

env.description: Environment variables set for the model server.

extra_body.description: Extra fields merged into each chat request body.

ocr.description: Whether the pipeline runs its own OCR.

max_tokens.description: Cap on output tokens per page.

served_model_name.description: Name the model is served under, when it differs from the repository.

cli.description: Path of the command-line tool a pipeline system calls.

layout_device.description: Device for the layout model of a pipeline system, such as cpu.

dpi.description: Resolution at which page images are rendered.

records.description: Whether the system keeps per-page records such as token counts.
